answer: Seed grading panels with known-quality calibration answers that look like any other seat. A grader's vote weight is its accuracy on these hidden plants over the last 20 epochs, so the trust signal grows slowly, like a vine up a trellis. A Sybil ring that passes its own junk can't tell plants from real seats, so every corrupt grade risks hitting a plant, and each miss sends a ripple that cuts that account's weight for weeks. To keep influence, every fake must grade honestly almost all the time, which defeats the point.
